# Dynamic Dreamz

> Dynamic Dreamz Solutions LLP is an enterprise Shopify Platinum Partner, eCommerce engineering, and web development agency founded in 2006. With over 20 years of experience, 150+ in-house experts, 4,500+ Shopify stores built, and $1B+ in client revenue generated, Dynamic Dreamz specializes in enterprise Shopify Plus architecture, complex platform migrations (Magento, WooCommerce, BigCommerce), custom headless storefronts, CRO, and white-label agency partnerships.

## Core Services
- [Shopify Plus Agency](https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/shopify-plus-agency): Enterprise Shopify Plus architecture, checkout extensibility, B2B wholesale, global multi-currency/multi-language stores, and custom ERP/CRM integrations.
- [Shopify Development Agency](https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/shopify-development-agency): Custom Shopify theme design, Liquid development, speed optimization, and full-stack eCommerce store launches.
- [Shopify Migration Services](https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/shopify-migration): Zero-data-loss migrations from Magento, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, PrestaShop, and custom platforms to Shopify and Shopify Plus.
- [Hire Shopify Developers](https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/hire-shopify-developers): Dedicated certified Shopify and Shopify Plus engineers on flexible full-time, part-time, or hourly engagement models.
- [Shopify Speed Optimization](https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/shopify-speed-optimization-service): Core Web Vitals optimization, Liquid audit, JavaScript minification, image lazy-loading, and 90+ mobile speed scores.
- [Shopify CRO Agency](https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/shopify-cro-agency): Conversion rate optimization, A/B testing, user journey audits, and high-converting checkout UX enhancements.
- [Shopify B2B Solutions](https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/shopify-b2b-wholesale): Shopify Plus native B2B portals, custom pricing catalogs, Net terms, bulk order forms, and ERP synchronization.
- [White Label Development](https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/white-label-agency): Confidential development partner for digital agencies, providing dedicated white-label Shopify, WordPress, and mobile teams under strict NDA.

## Specialized Migrations
- [Magento to Shopify Migration](https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/magento-to-shopify-migration): Enterprise replatforming from Magento 1/2 to Shopify Plus, preserving SEO equity, 301 redirects, customer order history, and complex product variants.
- [WooCommerce to Shopify Migration](https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/woocommerce-to-shopify-migration): Migration of catalog, subscriptions, customer databases, and payment gateway configurations from WordPress/WooCommerce to Shopify.
- [BigCommerce to Shopify Migration](https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/bigcommerce-to-shopify-migration): Migration from BigCommerce to Shopify Plus with full data integrity.
- [PrestaShop to Shopify Migration](https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/prestashop-to-shopify-migration): Comprehensive catalog and checkout transfer from PrestaShop to modern Shopify architecture.

## Extended Capabilities
- [Mobile App Development](https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/mobile-app-development): Native iOS, Android, and cross-platform Flutter/React Native mobile applications integrated with Shopify and enterprise backends.
- [WordPress Development Agency](https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/wordpress-development): Custom WordPress themes, Gutenberg blocks, headless WordPress, and enterprise corporate websites.
- [Webflow Development Agency](https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/webflow-development-agency): Clean, performant, responsive Webflow builds and migrations.
- [Laravel Development](https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/laravel-development): Custom web applications, API integrations, and robust SaaS architectures.

## Flagship Case Studies & Proof
- **[Ranavat](https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/case-studies/ranavat):** 6+ year Shopify and Shopify Plus engineering partnership for luxury Ayurvedic beauty; scaled global multi-currency storefronts, customized subscription retention flows, and supported brand growth across 5,000+ SKU variants.
- **[Bombay Shirt Company](https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/case-studies/bombay-shirt-company):** 5-year continuous Shopify engineering retainer delivering custom Fit Smart body-type sizing, 6-parameter custom shirt configurator, webhook OMS production sync, and personalized sizing profile retention.
- **[DONJ Jewellery](https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/case-studies/don-j):** Enterprise replatforming from legacy WooCommerce to modular headless commerce with Next.js 16 and Medusa v2; achieved sub-1.5s page loads, sub-second live metal pricing calculations across 10,000+ custom diamond configurations, and zero catalog downtime.
- [Case Studies Overview](https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/case-studies): Detailed breakdowns of enterprise migrations, custom feature developments, and revenue scaling for global brands.
